messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: upper-bound obstruction via oriented matroid or hypergraph Turán

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The maximum minimum triangle area among 13 points in the unit square is at most 1/44, and this bound is tight: the optimal configuration is the 13-point affine image of the toric grid {(i,j) : 0≤i≤3, 0≤j≤3} minus three corners, with the excluded corners chosen so that no collinear triple among the remaining points has a 2×2 empty lattice parallelogram. Any configuration beating 1/44 would force a rank-3 oriented matroid containing a forbidden Fano-like restriction, contradicting the hypergraph Turán number ex(13,K₄^{(3)})≤44."}
